title: PULSE BIOSCIENCES, INC. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-27
summary: Pulse Biosciences, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 25, 2026 announcing positive clinical trial results for its nPulse Cardiac Catheter System for treating atrial fibrillation. The study showed sustained procedural success rates of 100% at 6 months and 96% at one year, with a 1.7% serious adverse event rate. This is a medical device company regulatory filing with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: Pulse Biosciences filed Form 8-K disclosing clinical data from its nPulse Cardiac Catheter System study presented at Heart Rhythm 2026
Sustained 100% procedural success at 6 months (95/95 evaluable patients) and 96% at one year (51/53 evaluable patients)
Kaplan-Meier estimate showed 90% freedom from AF/AFL/AT at one year
Total procedure time averaged 60.2 minutes with 18.6 minutes left atrial dwell time
Serious adverse event rate of 1.7% (3/177 subjects) related to primary safety endpoint
Company is based in Miami, FL and trades as PLSE on Nasdaq
